positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Acted as a teaching assistant for ECE206, also known as Contemporary Logic Design, an introductory course in Princeton's Electrical and Computer Engineering department that teaches topics related to Boolean logic and basic hardware design. In this, I held office hours for assisting with problem sets and lab assignments.

company.name: Princeton University Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: During this internship, I was able to perform data analysis on various topics and how they potentially relate to human trafficking, and specifically OSEC (online sexual exploitation of children) in the Philippines and Lao PDR. I was able to create visual representations of my various findings, and my work culminated in a twelve-page written report on OSEC in the Philippines.
